overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains an active and highly academic social media presence across Bluesky, Mastodon, and LinkedIn, focusing heavily on computational social science, disinformation research, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. Across a total audience of 3,580 followers, his content consistently drives strong academic and professional engagement. High-profile milestones, such as paper publications, new grant funding, and recruitment opportunities (postdocs and PhD positions), are the strongest drivers of engagement across all three platforms.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, publications, and tool releases (such as CooRnet v2.0) focusing on computational methods for detecting coordinated social media campaigns.
Job openings and academic opportunities, specifically targeting postdoctoral researchers and PhD candidates within the computational social science domain.
Public announcements regarding newly awarded research grants and upcoming conference presentations like DisinfoConf2025.

recommendations: Capitalize on the highly active Bluesky audience by sharing more frequent behind-the-scenes progress updates, code snippets, or informal research discussions.
Incorporate visual media, such as screenshots of the CooRnet v2.0 dashboard or visual flowcharts of research findings, on Mastodon and LinkedIn to further boost click-throughs and shares.
Standardize recruitment posts across platforms by including clear, direct links to application portals and calls-to-action encouraging peers to share within their respective departments.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most highly engaging platform with an average engagement rate of 6.14% per post. Audience members are highly receptive to sharing opportunities and peer-reviewed outputs, characterized by a exceptionally strong repost-to-like ratio.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon yields a focused 4.55% average engagement rate. Concrete product releases like CooRnet updates resonate much more than open-ended methodological discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn represents the largest follower base (1,850) and generates the highest absolute interaction volume. It serves as the primary professional hub for high-impact announcements like major research funding and job recruitment.
